tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen gyi rnam thar kha bskongs ut+pa la'i chun po bzhugs so// na mo mañdzu badz+ra dwī ya sad+gu ru lā de bh+yaḥ sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las chu gter dbus/ /tshad med rin chen sna bzhi'i lhun po nyid/ /byang chub sems gnyis nyi zla'i dpal yon can/ /skal bzang gling bzhi'i mgon po de la 'dud/ /ces mchod par brjod nas lha dang bcas pa'i skye dgu thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu/ snyigs dus kyi 'gro ba ma rig pas ldongs pa rnams la yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba bskyed par mdzad pa'i sgron me chen po/ bdag cag la sogs pa'i 'os su gyur pa'i gdul bya rnams smin pa dang grol ba'i lam la 'god par mdzad pa/ dpag par dka' ba'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas dgung lo drug cu re lnga yan gyi rnam par thar pa dge legs rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba/ me mo glang gi lo la/ dpal sa skyar kho bo cag gi legs par bsgrigs shing / de phyin chad kyi ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar pa cung zad brjod na dgung lo re bdun bzhes pa nas bzung ste/ dpal e waṃ chos ldan/ ngam ring chos sde/ bzang ldan chos sde/ thub bstan rnam rgyal/ mus kyi dgon pa gong 'og rnams su/ gsung ngag lam 'bras tshar bcu gcig rdo rje phreng ba kṛ ya sa muts+tsha'i kha bskongs dang bcas pa tshar gnyis/ gzhan yang slob ma so so'i 'dod pa dang mthun par 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyis dbang / rim bzhi/ rim lnga/ rtsa dbu ma bde mchog dkar po'i 'khrid/ rdo rje bdag med ma'i dbang / byin brlabs/ gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dbang / rdzogs rim shin tu spros med/ gsang 'dus rigs gsum/ rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs kyi dbang / de dang 'brel ba'i rdzogs rim/ yig skor gyi lung / 'jigs byed sa lugs kyi dbang /

rnal 'byor rgyud la/ kun rig 'chi bdag 'joms pa/ bya spyod rigs gsum spyi dbang / tshe dpag med lha dgu/ gzhan yang lam 'bras dang 'brel ba'i byin brlabs/ 'khrid chung / dpe lung sogs brgyud pa'i bka' srol rnam par dag pa las byung ba rnams zhu mkhan su byung yang thugs ngal dub dang skyo sun med par slob ma rnams rjes su 'dzin par mdzad pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis rnam par thar pa'i gtso bo yin pas/ myang ngan las 'da' ba'i zhag bco lnga tsam yan chod du 'chad pa dang / rtsom pa dang / spros bcas dang / spros med kyi thugs dam mtha' yas pa'i nyin mtshan khor yug tu skad cig kyang mi g.yel bar mdzad la/ thugs dam gyi rim pa rnams ni/ mya ngan las 'da' ba'i sngon 'gro'i thun yan chad phran tshegs kyang ma lus par mdzad cing / mdor na sku tshe 'di nyid la snga phyir gsung ngag rin po che tshar lnga bcu nga gcig dang / gong du smos pa'i gsung chos kyi rnam grangs mtha' yas pas gdul bya rnams smin grol la 'god par mdzad cing / bsam gtan phug du bdud rtsi ril bu'i sgrub pa lan gnyis mdzad pa la'ang / grub pa'i rtags ches rmad du byung ba kun gyi ngo mtshar du 'dzin pa kho na yin la/ sngon gyi rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams dang / chos kyi rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge sogs bla ma gong ma rnams kyi rnam par thar pa dang mthun par/ chu mo lug gi lo'i mjug la/ dpal ldan sa skyar/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis gtso mdzad/ rten gsum rnams la mar khal lnga bcu tsam gyi dkar me dang / sgo rum gyi ma hā kā la dang / kha'u skyed lhas/ bzhi thog nang so sogs mgon khang so sor gtor gsol/ mda' dar 'bul ba la/ sa skya'i dus rim thog tu nyi shu brgyad kyi snga dro gtor bsgrub la byon pa'i dge 'dun rnams la mang ja/

gtor gsos bsgrub par gsol dpon nam mkha' dar po gnang byung zhing / spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang / khyad par byang phyogs su hor gyi gnod pa mi yong ba'i phrin las 'chol ba rje nyid kyis rgyas par mdzad/ bdag la'ang de lta bu'i bsngo ba smon lam srung 'khor sogs yang dag par bgyis ces pa'i bka' nan phebs pa ltar/ bdag cag rnams kyis kyang mos pa dang 'dun pa rtse gcig par bsgrubs shing / de rjes shing pho spre'u'i lo hor zla bzhi pa nas brtsams te/ dpal sa skya/ e waṃ chos ldan/ ngam ring chos sde/ bzang ldan/ thub bstan rnam rgyal/ thub bstan yangs pa can/ 'bras yul bskyed tshal/ nā len+d+ra'i chos sde/ mus lung pa'i dgon pa che chung rnams su mang ja/ 'gyed chas la gser zho phyed dang bzhi brgya/ dngul dam gnyis/ snam sbyar gser ma/ hor chol gnyis/ karma gan dkar gnyis/ gos yug gnyis/ dar yug sogs so so'i bla ma slob dpon rnams la bsngo rten/ dge 'dun spyi mang la gral 'gyed kyi dngos po bgrang ba las 'das pa gnang nas/ de dus kyi mi sna rnams la zhal ltar/ da lan gyi mang ja 'gyed chas 'di rnams rims 'gro ma yin/ nged kyi sngon 'gro'i dge rtsa yin la/ cho ga kun rig sogs tha dad kyi thugs la gang 'thad mdzad pas chog ces pa'i zhal bka' mdzad/ de dus blo gros dang ldan pa'i skyes bu kha yar gyis mgrin gcig par/ da lo dgung lo'i skeg yin pa dang / zhal lta'i gnang khyer 'di pa la bltas kyang / da lo tsam sku mtshams rgyun ring pa'i thugs dam rkyen bzlog gnang na legs pa 'dra zhes yang yang zhus kyang / da lo bde ldan phug tu lam 'bras cig ma bshad na/ khong tsho'i chos skal chad nyen yod/ ces gsung zhing / bde ldan phug tu gsung ngag gnang ba'i skabs cig la/ rje sems dpa' chen po'i thugs dam bde ba can gyi zhing bkod 'di dang / chos rje kun dga' mchog ldan pas nged rang la phul ba'i bde ba can gyi bkod pa gnyis lag tu byung /

da nga rang yang 'di lta bu cig bzhengs dgos pa 'dug ces gsungs nas/ mus sa nag gi bris pa ka bcu pa zhes pa la bde ba can gyi zhing bkod bris bcug 'od dpag med kyi sku mdun du/ nga rang gi gzugs cig kyang bris zhes bka' gnang / bris sku la rjes rab gnas legs par mdzad nas/ 'o da lo bde ba can gyi zhing bkod kyang gsum 'byor byung / bzang spyod la kha ton byas nas tshe mjug 'di rnams la skyabs gnas zhu dgos pa 'dug ces pa dang / yang skabs zhig na/ bla ma nam chos pa zhes bya ba bzang spyod nyin re bzhin zhal 'don mdzad pa zhig yod pa sku gshegs rjes/ rje sems dpa' chen po'i gzigs snang la bde ba can gyi zhing bkod gzigs pas bla ma nam chos pa yang bde ba can na 'khrungs 'dug bzang spyod 'di kha ton 'chag med byas na bde ba can du skye nges pa 'dug ces gsung ba'i gsung sgros mdzad/ sku gshegs pa la nye ba'i dus/ drung na gnas pa rnams kyi da dung sku tshe bsring ba'i thabs dang / sems can gyi don du brtan par bzhugs pa'i thugs 'dun gnang dgos ces gsol ba btab pas/ nged rang skye 'chi la dbang thob pa ma yin mod/ 'on kyang las bsags pa med ces gsung / de'i don ni mi dge ba'i las bsags med ces pa ma yin gyi/ sku tshe de bas lhag pa bzhugs pa'i sems can spyi mthun gyi las bsags pa med pa mkhyen te/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis yon tan la sngon gyi gnas dang / 'chi 'pho ba dang / skye ba shes pa dang / las dang / smon lam shes pa zhes 'byung ba ltar yin/ de rjes ma 'ongs pa na bya ba rnam gzhag ji ltar byed kyi bka' lung zhus pas/ sngar gyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyis dus mchod la dmigs pa'i gzhi rten dang / dkar me'i cha rkyen 'di rnams gzhan dang ma 'dres pa dmigs su 'khyol nges bsgrubs/ nga rang gi pha gzhis mtshon tsam 'di dang / gzhan zhing chung 'dra kha yar yod pa 'di rnams sngar gyi dus mchod dkar me gang la yang bsngos pa med cing /

'dres med yin pas nga rang gi dus mchod kyi gzhi rten gyis/ dgon pa gong 'og 'di rnams kyis gdan sa ngam rings su sde pa dpon blon la bka' gros zhus zhes pa sogs ma 'ongs pa mkhyen pa'i zhal bkod mthar phyin mdzad/ bde ldan phug tu gsung ngag grol la nye ba'i hor zla bdun pa gro bzhin zla ba'i tshes bzhi nas sku khams cung zhig bsnyel ba'i tshul bstan nas/ phyag phyir yod pa rnams kyi gsung chos 'di bsdu ba gnang na legs pa 'dra zhes zhus pa ltar tshes bcu bdun gyi nyin/ lus dkyil gyi dmigs pa dang / gsang dbang gi dmigs pa rnams shar pa zhig gsungs nas/ nged khams cung mi bde bas chos 'phro de tsam gyi rdzogs pa gyis la/ chos nyan pa rnams so sor gyis ces pa'i bka' lung gnang / gling kha bde ba can du phebs na dgongs pa'i thugs 'dun bzhin/ hor zla brgyad pa khrums kyi zla ba'i tshes gcig la bde ldan phug nas yar phebs/ bar zhag gnyis mdzad nas gling khar phebs te/ tshes lnga'i snga dro yan la sku khams cung mi bde ba'i rnam pa mdzad/ nyi phyed tsam nas sku khams log pa'i rnam pa cung zhig byung kyang / tshes drug gi nyin byang khang gsar ba'i dpon mo sogs gshin po kha cig don du kun rig gi cho ga dang / ming byang bsreg pa sogs mdzad nas/ de pa tshar bas blo bde gsung / de nas sku tshe 'di nyid kyi gdul bya gzhan don rnams rdzogs nas/ zhing khams gzhan du 'gro don rgya che bar mkhyen bzhin du/ blo dman pa'i gdul bya rtag par zhen pa rnams nges 'byung gi bsam pa bskyed pa'i phyir/ sgrol byed ces pa shing pho spre'u'i lo khrums kyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs tshes bcu'i tho rangs rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i 'da' kha ma zab mo gsal btab ste/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bzhugs pa la spyan gyis gzigs nas/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya mdzad bzhin par dgongs pa 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du thim pa'i tshul bstan/

tshes bcu gnyis kyi tho rangs thugs dam las bzhengs nas/ thogs pa med par bde ba can du rje bla ma yab sras kyi drung du gshegs pa la yid gnyis dang the tshom mi dgos pa lags/ de nas brtsams te/ sku gdung gi drung du/ gle lung mkhan po dkon mchog rin chen pa dang / bde ldan phug gi chos 'chad slob dpon rab 'byams pa thugs rje bas gtso byas/ kyai rdo rje'i rtsa sngags 'bum phrag brgya song ba'i dge slong byang chub ces pa dang / 'khor lo bde mchog gi rtsa sngags la bsnyen pa song ba'i dge slong gnyis sogs bde kye'i gzhi bsnyen tshad du 'khyol ba'i dge slong bcu gnyis kyis/ snga dgongs kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi sgrub mchod phyag len bzhin dang / gtor ma brgya rtsa sogs thugs dam gyi gsal 'debs dgung zhag ma grol bar la mdzad/ gzhan don la gshegs nas zhag bdun lon pa'i bcu bdun gyi nyin/ kho bo cag dgon pa 'dir slebs/ zla ba gcig gi bar la 'khor lo bde mchog nag po pa'i sgrub mchod dang / bla ma mchod chog bde mchog rgyud nas bshad pa nyin re ma chag par bsgrubs/ zla ba 'di'i nyer bzhi nas gsol 'debs dngos gzhi btsugs te/ zhag bdun gyi bar la snga dro kun rig gi bdag bskyed bsnyen pa rgyas pa dang bcas pa'i sgrub mchod dang / dgongs mo kyai rdo rje'i sgrub mchod dge 'dun tshogs pa drug brgya tsam gyis legs par phul/ de bar gyi zhabs tog bla brang nas gzhi bzung / sbyin bdag so sos kha bskongs dang bcas nas nyin re bzhin mang ja gnyis re/ za ma 'dren thang gsum la re re bzhin tsam pa bre re dang / mar nyag do tsam re'i bsnyen bkur bsgrubs/ de nas zhal chems bzhin tha skar zla ba'i tshes bcu'i nyin mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur las bshad pa ltar 'grel pa gur rgyan dang / dus tha ma'i cho ga gzhan phan bdud rtsi las ji ltar bshad pa bzhin gyi sku gdung chas 'jug dang /

lus dkyil la brten pa'i dbang bskur gsal 'debs 'bul ba sogs cho ga kha tshar tshang bar bgyis/ tshes bcu gcig gi tho rangs kyai rdo rje'i bdag bskyed sngon du song ba'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg tshul bzhin du sku gdung zhugs la phul zhing / tshes bcu gsum gyi nyin gdung khang zhal phye te/ smon lam legs par btab/ sku gdung la sku khrus gsol te/ sku gdung byin gdung sgam du gdan drangs nas phyag rgyas btab pa la mchod pa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas nas bzhugs su gsol/ de dag gi bar thams cad dang dus kyi mchod pa sogs kyi tshe/ nam mkha' las lha rnams me tog gi char rab tu mang po 'bebs pa dang / lha'i spos dri zhim pos kun tu gang ba/ nyi ma'i 'od zer kyang chu 'dzin gyis ma sgribs par ches cher gsal bar mthong ba ni kun gyis mthun snang grub pa lags/ sku gdung la zhugs ma phul gong du byin rlabs zhus pa'i tshe'ang / tha mal pa'i dri nga cung zad kyang med par lha dang mi'i dri bzang po thams cad las lhag pa'i tshul khrims kyi dri bzang ches mnams pa dang / zhugs la phul ba'i tshe dang gdung khang nas spyan 'dren pa'i dus kyang dri zhim po phul du byung ba thams cad kyis tshor bar byung ba ni/ thugs brgyud la bzhugs pa so thar/ byang sems/ sngags kyi sdom pa thams cad la nyes ltung gi dri ma phra zhing phra bas kyang ma gos pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag pa yin pas/ dam pa 'di'i slob ma gang zag thams cad kyang yid gtan thub par gyis shig de rjes lo de nyid la/ nang rten thub dbang gi gser sku mtho bcu yod pa dang / gzim mal sku 'dra mda' tshad cig bzhengs pa'i sku la gser zho nyi shu rtsa bzhi phul cing / nang du byin rlabs rten sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i ring bsrel/ rje rdo rje 'chang / sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ grub chen dkon mchog blo gros pa rnams kyi gdung tsha stobs che ba/

kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge dang / rje nyid kyi ring bsrel/ dbu skra/ gdung tsha/ na bza'i sna grangs sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs shing / phyi rten byang chub chen po'i mchod rten/ rje sems dpa' chen po'i rnam rgyal mchod rten dang sku tshad mnyam pa/ rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang bzhugs sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel/ thub dbang gi sku sogs gser sku mang po dang / rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi phyag nas bzhugs pa'i rigs lnga'i bris sku/ yum rgyas pa cha gcig sogs gsung rab/ thugs kyi rten rnams rgyal mchod rten gser las grub pa/ rje nyid kyi sku 'dra gser zangs las byas pa/ phyag nas ma dang / gzhan yang ring bsrel/ gdung thal/ gdung tsha/ na bza'/ spur khang sa phag sogs byin rlabs kyi rten stobs che ba bzhugs pa rnams kyang bya lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes brgyad yan chad la legs par grub cing / tshes dgu la phyi rten gyi rab gnas dang / tshes bcu la nang rten gyi rab gnas/ bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis pa sku mched dang / gle lung mkhan chen dkon mchog rin chen pas gtso mdzad/ sdom gsum ldan zhing / gsang sngags kyi bsnyen bsgrub mthar phyin pa'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa bdun gyis/ kyai rdor sgrub mchod dang sgrel/ rab tu gnas shing bkra shis pa'i cho ga rgyas par mdzad/ bde ba can na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun rnams la yang yang ja gdan bzhes bdud rtsi ril bu bzhi re dang / skye bdun ril bu re/ gzhan yang zang zing gi 'gyed dang bcas pa/ mus stod kyi khyim pa rnams la yang / ston mo zan mar skye bdun ril bu dang bcas pa'i 'gyed legs par bsgrub/ gong du smos pa'i nang rten la/ rje de nyid rgyun bzhes ling ngur kha'i snam sbyar dang / gzhan yang gos dar gyi chos gos/ dbu thog tu bla bre/ gzim mal sku 'dra la yang gos chen gyi sku chos/

snyan dar/ gos snyel/ gos 'bol/ gsol spang / mdun du mchod cog steng na/ gsol lhung / phyag dril sogs mchod chas tshang ma yod cing / dkar me'i gzhi rten la 'bri brgya/ gser gyi spyi khebs che chung gnyis la gser zho brgyad cu gya gnyis/ yum gyi mgul g.yu srang gang ri ba rnams dang / dus mchod rgyun gyi thes la gser zho brgya/ nas khal stong dang sum brgya/ mar khal brgya tsam/ 'bri g.yag ra lug sum brgya skor/ zhing khal bco lnga/ ja sigs gsum rnams/ bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis pa la rtsis phul/ phyi nang gi rten rnams bzhengs pa'i bzo bo tha dad la yang / yon rdzong gser dngul khro zangs gos dar 'bri g.yag gos rnams bkon/ skyon so so'i bsam pa tshim par bsgrubs pa 'di dag gi do dam rkang len gsol dpon thugs rje bzang po dang / nam mkha' dar pos legs par bsgrub nas/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams byin brlabs gzi 'od 'bar bar bzhugs shing / gzhan yang gangs can gyi khrod 'dir/ rje nyid kyi slob ma dang / dad pa can gyi sbyin bdag gis lo dang zla ba'i dus mchod 'chag med du sgrub pa dang / rje nyid kyi gsung rab la 'chad nyan sgom sgrub byed pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsam gyis mi khyab pas bstan pa dang sems can gyi 'gro don/ phrin las chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du nyi zla gnas kyi bar spel bar byed do/ /rgya chen chos kyi sku las rab sprul pa'i/ /thugs rje'i gzugs brnyan gdul bya'i me long la/ /legs par shar ba'i rnam thar rgya mtsho las/ /cung zad bsdus te bris pa'i dge ba gang / /rab dkar kun dga'i phung po ltar thob des/ /'gro kun rdo rje theg pa'i lam zhugs nas/ /rab dga' la sogs bcu gnyis sa bgrod de/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang myur thob shog /bdag sogs gdul bya'i slob mar gyur pa rnams/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab rgya mtsho legs thob nas/ /de don bsam dang zab mo'i don bsgom zhing /

/rje btsun nyid kyis thugs rjes 'dzin par shog /ces pa 'di ni rje nyid kyis dgung lo drug cu re lnga zhes pa yan gyi rnam par thar pa brtsams nas lo bcu 'das pa na/ sa mo glang gi lo cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes nyer lnga la/ dpal sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dpal ldan sa skya yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas su bris pa'o// //e waṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 8 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen gyi rnam thar kha bskongs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
